title: Bearing.
officialText:
Except where supported on a 1-inch by 4-inch (25.4 mm by 102 mm) ribbon strip and nailed to
the adjoining stud, the ends of each joist shall not have less than 11/2 inches (38 mm) of bearing on wood or metal,
or less than 3 inches (76 mm) on masonry.
